msgid: To establish a smuggling route, you need to build a warehouse on a sending/receiving spot while your team mate has to build one on the corresponding receiving/sending spot. A ware is then transported every 10 seconds.
For harder to defend smuggling routes, you get 2 or 3 points per ware smuggled. The first team to collect %s wins.

Remember that the map has rotational symmetry. For example, when you have found a spot to the top-left of your headquarters, the corresponding spot will be to the bottom-right of the headquarters of your team mate.
You can see the number of wares traded at any time in the general statistics menu. Good luck!
A new smuggling route from %1$s to %2$s has been established! Every ware they smuggle there is worth %3$s.
note: TRANSLATORS: the first 2 parameters are player names, the last parameter is | '<number> points'

msgid: Your team has established a new smuggling route. You have the sending warehouse. Every ware smuggled here is worth %s.
Your team has established a new smuggling route. You have the receiving warehouse. Every ware smuggled here is worth %s.
The smuggling route worth %1$s from %2$s to %3$s has been broken!
note: TRANSLATORS: the first parameter is '<number> points', the last 2 | parameters are player names

msgid: Game over! %1$s and %2$s have won the game! %3$s and %4$s only managed to collect %5$s.
note: TRANSLATORS: the first 4 parameters are player names, the last parameter is | '<number> points'

msgid: Smugglers is a fun map for 4 players. You and your partner start diagonally from each other on a point symmetric island. There are plenty of smuggling tunnels on this island, each consisting of a receiving and a sending end.
